# Ordered list continuation source

`illumos-getopts.1` is the complete `usr/src/man/man1/getopts.1` file
from [illumos-gate e8f5c080cc0b7997410d860afd787df30ba1cf2d](https://github.com/illumos/illumos-gate/blob/e8f5c080cc0b7997410d860afd787df30ba1cf2d/usr/src/man/man1/getopts.1).
It was selected from the November 18, 2026 review and checked byte for byte
against that commit in the retained upstream checkout and the corresponding
page in [mant-roff-corpus](https://github.com/BryanHeBY/mant-roff-corpus/tree/832e18b3645884dd1d04dc34ebd656015e5a8e71/corpora/illumos-gate-e8f5c080).
This is a direct repository file, with no archive extraction or transformation.
The source and fixture SHA-256 is `546dff38cbfb44bba62bd06ccfe0ccb8a4131b166964e800931ce154039bfc83`.

The upstream copyright lines and the complete IEEE/The Open Group
POSIX Issue 6 reprint notice are retained in the source. The complete
[CDDL text](../LICENSES/CDDL-1.0.txt) matches `usr/src/OPENSOLARIS.LICENSE`
at the same illumos revision (Git blob
`da23621dc843ef762a04d3e9937be4ef485adc9d`).

The pinned pristine CVS rendered the complete file in ASCII, UTF-8, HTML and
tree mode with exit 0. Lint exited 2, including warnings for blank lines in
fill mode interpreted as `.sp`. [The manifest](manifest.json) records these
runs with the basename as the working directory relative input. The fixture
test checks pairing and order of the six consecutive flag labels and their
description prefixes in text, JSON transport and actual Markdown readback.
It does not assert the complete native terminal layout.
